answer: LIST st, ci, zi, sta FROM Satscore has SatscoreNumGE1500 g AND ALSO has SatscoreNumTstTakr t AND ALSO (g / t) AS rate AND ALSO has SchoolStreet st AND ALSO has SchoolCity ci AND ALSO has SchoolZip zi AND ALSO has SchoolState sta ORDERED WITH rate ASCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST n FROM Frpm [has SchoolDOC: '31'] has SchoolSchool n AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 e ORDERED WITH e DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST g FROM School OPTIONALLY has SchoolGSoffered g AND ALSO has SchoolLongitude lo ORDERED WITH abs(lo) DESCENDING THE FIRST 1

LIST n, doc FROM Frpm [has SchoolFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has SchoolSchool n AND ALSO has SchoolDOC doc AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a WHERE k - a > THE AVERAGE d IN (Frpm [has SchoolFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k2 AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a2 AND ALSO (k2 - a2) AS d)
LIST n FROM Frpm has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has FrpmFreeMealCountK12 f AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 e AND ALSO has SatscoreNumGE1500 g WHERE f / e > 0.1 AND g > 0
LIST c, n FROM School s [has SchoolVirtual: 'F'] has SchoolCounty c AND ALSO THE COUNT OF s GROUPED BY c AS n WHERE c = 'San Diego' OR c = 'Santa Barbara' ORDERED WITH n DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
